source_note: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散
english_source_note: Competing Decreasing Sequences and Series Divergence
callout_id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#1
statement_en: Let $a_n$ be a nonnegative nonincreasing real sequence, and suppose the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} a_n$ diverges. Prove that the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} \min\{a_n,1/n\}$ diverges.
callout_body: $a_n$是一个非负不增的实数列，并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$发散。证明级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{a_n,1/n\}$发散。
